candidate.name: posw17_mixstyle
candidate.idea: MixStyle-based domain generalization on stage2/3 feature statistics

interpretation.pattern: MixStyle pushes the classifier toward a more malignant-biased operating region. Recall increases, but both internal and external specificity degrade heavily, and BUSI AUC drops well below the reference line.
interpretation.combined_read_with_previous_runs: ArcMargin and SupCon over-correct toward conservatism; MixStyle over-corrects toward aggressiveness. The stable issue is domain-sensitive decision bias, not a single-direction lack of separation.
interpretation.next_best_direction: Move to learnable bias / threshold shaping with explicit internal validation constraints instead of another feature-loss sweep.
